notes.author: ted
notes.text: Jasmine joined the student worship team. She sings with confidence and helps the younger students learn their parts.
notes.testPurpose: A note on a child written more than two years ago.

notes.author: pete
notes.text: Sent Jasmine a graduation card from the pastors. Marcus said she will start college soon and wants to find a church near campus.

replies.author: ted
replies.text: I'll send her a short list of churches near her school.
